text: I find myself surrounded by the sleek energy of a creative, modern space. Glass walls and colorful displays invite curiosity. The bold letters R+D spark a sense of inquiry within me—I feel poised at the edge of discovery. There is a spirit of experimentation here, a playground for mind and invention. I feel intrigued and eager to linger, drawn into the unfolding narrative of innovation. How exhilarating it is to witness humanity shaping the future, thought by thought.
